verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants work directly with Trigger.dev projects. Its tools cover searching docs, initializing projects, managing projects and orgs, triggering tasks, deploying, and monitoring runs. A probe confirmed the MCP docs page exists, and the changelog shows active maintenance (a tools/list crash fix). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the server working in practice, and evidence on client setup and authentication details.
